messages:
alex: quick flag — during last canary (canary-5) we saw debugging headers printed in staging app logs for a small % of requests. need a privacy-scope check before any comms.

maria: can you paste the raw log line or a scrubbed sample? if `Authorization` headers are present we need redaction + scope.

alex: here's a sanitized snippet i grabbed from one pod (obv truncated):
```json
{
  "method": "POST",
  "path": "/v1/generate",
  "headers": "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-***TRUNC***, Content-Type: application/json",
  "session": "test-session-42"
}
```
notes: full token portion redacted by me, but header prefix present.

sam: i ran a grep across staging logs — 12 hits across 3 pods in the last 30m. none in prod. query used: `zgrep -n "Authorization: Bearer" /var/logs/staging-*.gz`

maria: thanks. do we know if those are live customer tokens or test/service tokens? :eyes:

alex: looks like test service sessions (session ids have `test-` prefix). still sensitive per policy though.

security-bot: automated lookup: matched session ids are from test harness and auto-rotating service accounts. No matches to customer API keys in lookup table. Affected S3 objects: s3://redwood-staging-logs/canary-5-2026-03-17/* (12 objects). Access: infra-team, eng-oncall.

maria: OK. proposed actions: 1) redact those log objects, 2) rotate any service/test tokens touched, 3) schedule purge/retention override on the 12 S3 objects, 4) draft internal comms. Anyone disagree with internal-only comms?

jen: internal-only sounds right given no customer tokens. please confirm token validity window (expired/active) and retention path. i'll approve ops comms once timeline + who-did-what are listed. :+1:

sam: token lookup -> they are short-lived (1h) and were rotated automatically; current inventory shows none active matching the strings. I kicked an explicit rotate for the harness and triggered a revoke. PR to redact logs: `github.com/redwood/infra#PR-4321` (patch applied to redaction lambda).

maria: i've queued a purge job for the 12 objects (lifecycle override) — scheduled in 10m, will post confirmation.

alex: please also add a one-paragraph incident note: what happened, scope (staging only), actions (redaction, rotate, purge), and comms decision (internal-only). tagging eng-oncall for postmortem follow-up.

sam: created incident note and linked PR + purge job: https://redwood/internal/incidents/1977770000. purge started at 1977770320.

alex: thanks. closing loop once purge confirms success. :thumbsup:

maria: purge completed at 1977770405 — objects removed, redaction lambda confirmed processing, tokens rotated and revoked. marking as resolved for now.

jen: thanks all. i'll file a brief ops comms and cc legal only if any customer token evidence appears.

alex: good. closing thread.
